title: Agent check, a re-run after a refused answer
about: A short line is repeated on two pages of the stability report, so the server refuses it as a quote (quote_repeated). The request carries that reason. The new answer must cite a line that appears once.

check.question: Is long-term stability data given at 30 C / 65% RH for 12 months?

previous_rejection.message: The quote 'Long-term studies: 30 C / 65% RH, 18 months.' is refused: the same words appear elsewhere in this document, so they don't point here.

pages:
Cover letter

Halden Biotech FZ-LLC submits an application to register Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets, containing corvanidine hydrochloride. The enclosed files are the application form, the quality overall summary, the stability report and the leaflet. The product is a generic of a reference product registered in another country. Please contact the regulatory affairs office for any question.

2.3 Quality Overall Summary

This summary follows the structure of Module 3 for Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets. The finished product is manufactured at Halden Biotech FZ-LLC, Plant 3, Ajman.

2.3.P.8 Stability

The stability data in Module 3.2.P.8 support the shelf life and the storage statement proposed for the product.

Stability report: Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets

Prepared by Halden Biotech FZ-LLC, Quality Unit.
Long-term studies: 30 °C / 65% RH, 18 months.

Study design

Three commercial-scale batches were studied in the proposed blister.
Long-term studies: 30 °C / 65% RH, 18 months.

Results

Data for all three batches stored at 30 °C ± 2 °C / 65% RH ± 5% RH are available to the 18 month time point, and they show no significant change in assay, dissolution or related substances.

Conclusion

A shelf life of 36 months is proposed for the product in the proposed pack.

Patient information leaflet

Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets
Read all of this leaflet carefully before you start taking this medicine.
What Corvane is: Corvane lowers high blood pressure in adults.

How to take Corvane

The usual adult dose is one tablet (500 mg) twice daily with food.
Store below 30 °C. Keep the tablets in the original package.

law.title: Example Guideline on Stability Data for Registration

clauses.text: Scope. This guideline applies to applications to register a finished pharmaceutical product that will be stored and sold in climatic zone IVb, a hot and humid zone.
Long-term data. The applicant shall provide long-term stability data generated at 30 °C ± 2 °C and 65% RH ± 5% RH, covering at least 12 months at the time of submission, on at least three batches.
Accelerated data. Accelerated data shall be generated at 40 °C ± 2 °C and 75% RH ± 5% RH for 6 months. Accelerated data do not replace long-term data.
Shelf life. The proposed shelf life shall not be longer than the period covered by real-time data unless a written extrapolation is given and justified.
Reporting. A stability report shall give the batch numbers, the pack, the storage conditions, the time points and the results in tables.
